neighbours.label: lifting weights: strength lifts such as squats, deadlifts and barbell or dumbbell work
fire: My coach told me to keep my back straight when I squat heavy.
She can now deadlift twice her body weight after a year in the gym.
Load two plates on each side of the barbell before your bench press.
He set a personal record by squatting 180 kilograms at the meet.
Olympic weightlifters spend years perfecting the clean and jerk.
Grip the dumbbells firmly and press them slowly over your head.
Powerlifting meets judge the squat, the bench and the deadlift.
After warming up, I added another twenty pounds to the bar for my last set.
quiet: My coach told me to keep my back straight when I run downhill.
She can now run twice her old distance after a year on the track.
Fill two bottles with water before your long ride on the bike.
He set a personal record by swimming 1500 metres at the meet.
Marathon runners spend years perfecting their pacing strategy.
Grip the handlebars firmly and pedal slowly up the hill.
Triathlons combine swimming, cycling and running in one race.
After warming up, I added another two laps around the track for my last set.

notes: Card: ' squat' x3, ' lifting' x3, 'weightl-ifter', 'hex bar for deadlifts', 'drop the weights'. The + pole is general exercise benefits. Near misses keep sport/fitness without lifting (running, swimming, cycling).
